name: Jenna Burgess
source:
Fred’s older sister, she works as a maid alongside her brother at Donna's grandmother’s house in London. She takes her job seriously, and is often seen scolding her brother when he makes a mistake. Although she is often perceived as quick-tempered, she is actually a kind and devoted woman. Apparently, she is quite skilled at sewing.

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/tea/teaparty.htm]official website[/url]]
